sources: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Safdarjung & Lodhi Road Observatories
Central Water Commission (CWC) Old Railway Bridge Gauge Station
Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) Flood Incident Reports July 2023
description: Historic monsoon downpour (153 mm in 24h, highest July rainfall since 1982) coupled with extreme Hathnikund Barrage discharge (3.59 lakh cusecs), causing Yamuna water level to breach the all-time 45-year record (208.66 m vs 1978 record of 207.49 m). Submerged Ring Road, ITO junction, Pragati Maidan tunnel, and Kashmere Gate ISBT.
